page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at the top, with the page number at the upper left; below it the emblem title; then a woodcut emblem (hands holding a balance and a sword above a draped object); below the woodcut four lines of italic verse; catchword at the lower right.

p.i: Lubrica, mortalis, premis ô vestigia, iuris
Quisquis es, ambiguas quando sequere vias:
Aerea vt incautum laedunt[?] tormenta virum, sic

page.notes: The woodcut shows two hands emerging from clouds at the sides: the left hand holds a small balance with two pans, the right hand holds an upright sword. Between them stands a vertical rod, and at its base a draped cloth-covered object with a hilled landscape behind. No printed text inside the woodcut. "laedunt" is read as "ladunt" in the scan and marked doubtful. The catchword "Sclope-" is set in italic and is a hyphenated word beginning, probably "Sclopetum".
